ai_assessment.method: Full direct Chinese-to-Vietnamese comparison of all 78 canonical passages and both titles. Separate subagent drafting from the original preceded review. A separate-context assessor (same model family, not shown the drafter’s notes or scores) read every pair first and reported 1 major and 16 minor findings with a pre-revision weighted score of 8.7; the drafter revised the text, re-read the changed passages and the whole target for naturalness, then obtained a second fresh separate-context assessment of the revised text (8.925, no major findings), applied its fixes, and assigned these final scores bound to the final byte hashes.
ai_assessment.limitations: The same AI system drafted, revised and assessed the work; the separate-context pass is correlated same-model feedback, not independent review or model diversity. No human literary reviewer, native-reader trial or measured reader demand is claimed. Existing Vietnamese translations were not consulted or collated. Scores are subjective and uncalibrated; missed errors may remain. Source clearance is separately recorded and is not granted by this review.

findings.explanation: The evolution speech reversed the comparison (the cannibals’ shame said to be smaller than the worms’ before the monkeys); now far greater, as in the source.
The 不能 pun restored as ‘không được’ in both the madman’s plea and the brother’s refusal of the tenants; 要好 aligned with 1.55.
趕緊喫罷 keeps its double reading (medicine / eating) as ‘Cho dùng ngay đi!’; 意外 and 古來 corrected (1.18).
狼子 as lũ sói con echoing Lang Tử; ledger, ages, sister’s death, ‘cùng một bọn’ and other calques corrected.
海乙那 (hyena) kept as the transliteration Hải Ất Na without a note, as the madman’s strange borrowed word.

summary: Full assessment of all 78 Chinese/Vietnamese passages — the classical preface, thirteen diary entries and the dateline — and both titles. The madman’s fear of the Zhao dog, the history book, the doctor, the brother, the sister’s death, the evolution speech and the closing appeal are complete, with the register contrast between preface and diary intact. The first separate-context pass scored 8.70 but reported one major finding (the evolution speech’s comparison reversed) that blocked release; it and the minor findings were revised, and a second fresh separate-context assessment found no major issue and scored the text 8.925. Fidelity, voice, imagery and mechanics are 9.0, naturalness 8.5. Unrounded weighted score 8.925 meets the unchanged 8.6 threshold. No unresolved major or critical issue remains.

title_review.rationale: Nhật ký người điên is the established Vietnamese title; the preface notes that the diarist named it himself after his recovery.
